desc: Moon spirit: crescent-moon shaped pale body with small gold stars, tiny feet. Face: calm sleepy droopy half-closed eyes with long lashes on the crescent's inner curve. Abstract spirit creature, no animal parts. Cute and cool chibi, right-facing 3/4. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. Lavender, white, violet, gold palette. No halo, sparkles or shadow.
